dialect_note: JSON-Schema subset (type/required/properties/additionalProperties/enum/const/pattern/minimum/items/minItems/$ref) interpreted by tests/s1_contract_judge.py, plus x-cross-field-rules implemented in the same judge. No SQLite is created in S1.

x-time-contract.source_close_time_ms: Binance close_time = open + tf_ms - 1 (kept for traceability only)
x-time-contract.decision_boundary: trigger_bar_close_ms = open + tf_ms = the instant the bar is closed and may be judged; occurred_at_ms == trigger_bar_close_ms (发生时间); decision_bar_close_ms = close of the bar that decided the status of THIS revision (A T or T+1 close, B h or h+1 close, C a bar close within T+1..T+10); every source_versions.effective_at_ms <= decision_bar_close_ms
x-time-contract.system_times: ISO-8601 UTC strings with Z or +00:00, microsecond precision allowed: first_seen_at (首次发现, never refreshed by rescans/backfill/revisions), available_at (all inputs available to the system = max(source_versions.available_at)), revision_recorded_at (when this revision was written), first_confirmed_seen_at (首次确认发现)
x-time-contract.ordering: available_at >= trigger_bar_close_ms; revision 1: first_seen_at >= available_at and revision_recorded_at == first_seen_at; later revisions: revision_recorded_at >= first_seen_at and >= available_at; first_confirmed_seen_at >= confirm_bar_close_ms, >= first_seen_at and <= revision_recorded_at
x-time-contract.legacy_A_confirm_time: old A confirm_time (ema_event_timing.py:48 confirm_time=now_s) is SYSTEM DISCOVERY time. It may be carried only as confirm.legacy_confirm_time with legacy_confirm_time_semantics='system_discovery_time' and must be >= confirm_bar_close_ms; it is never used as candle close. The candle is confirm_bar_open_ms/confirm_bar_close_ms (legacy confirm_bar_time = close_time = open + 4h - 1).
x-time-contract.display: pages show Asia/Shanghai; storage is UTC

x-identity-contract.A_and_C_event_id: {strategy}|{event_kind}|{market}|{symbol}|{timeframe}|{rule_version}|{trigger_bar_open_ms}  (strategy and event_kind are REQUIRED fields and part of the id)
x-identity-contract.A_technical_identity: independent of the candidate cycle: event_id never contains candidate_cycle_id; candidate_cycle_id is a separate nullable link to the real ema_squeeze_store cycle
x-identity-contract.B_event_id: B KEEPS its original id: 'bev-' + uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, 'B_ACCUMULATION_1H|b-accum-1h-v1|{market}|{symbol}|1h|{trigger_bar_open_ms}|tech_h').hex (b_accumulation_store.stable_event_id). strategy and event_kind are still required fields (B / b_tech_h) and are inside the uuid5 name. Tracking profile identity is stored separately on the session (tracking_profile_id + tracking_profile_version), never folded into the B event_id.
x-identity-contract.C_event_id: new: C|c_cycle|{market}|{symbol}|4h|c-1015-v1.1|{t0_open_ms}; a corrected T0 creates a new id with supersedes link (never silent primary-key rewrite)

x-revision-contract.state_progression: every state change of the event (A pending->confirmed/void, B pending->confirmed/confirm_failed, C waiting->confirmed/invalidated/expired) is appended as a NEW revision with revision_reason state_progression; revision_recorded_at of the first revision that carries status confirmed == confirm.first_confirmed_seen_at (首次确认发现时间). An event that is already decided at its trigger close (A confirmed on T) may be revision 1 directly.
x-revision-contract.late_backfill: evidence that arrives after a decision (e.g. a missing C bar after expiry) appends a revision with discovery late_backfill; it never rewrites earlier revisions and never extends the C lifetime
x-revision-contract.retention: append-only; every revision and its source_versions are retained; never delete or overwrite; old notifications retained (1015 §7.3)
x-revision-contract.first_seen_preserved: first_seen_at is the identity's first discovery and is identical across revisions
x-revision-contract.transitions: corrections are new transitions with revision>1 and corrects_transition_id

x-evidence-contract.source_versions: array of {source, ref, version, effective_at_ms, available_at, payload_sha256}; effective_at_ms <= max(trigger_bar_close_ms, confirm_bar_close_ms)
x-evidence-contract.evidence_hash: sha256 hex of canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators (',',':'), ensure_ascii=False, UTF-8) of source_versions sorted by (source, ref, version)
x-evidence-contract.aggregation: one event revision aggregates every input that decided it (candles, OI, LSR, cap, background); a changed input = a new revision with a new evidence_hash; the old revision keeps its own list

x-cross-field-rules.rule: event_id composition (A/C new format; B legacy bev- uuid5) and rule_version per strategy
A event_id never contains candidate_cycle_id; candidate_cycle_id only for A (null for B/C)
timeframe per strategy (A 4h, B 1h, C 4h); open on grid; close = open + tf; source_close_time = open + tf - 1

occurred_at_ms == trigger_bar_close_ms; decision_bar_close_ms (close of the bar that decided this revision status) is a bar close >= trigger close, inside the rule window (A <= T+1 close, B <= h+1 close, C <= T+10 close = T0 open + 11x4H, so a late backfill can never move a C decision past the real lifetime) and == confirm_bar_close_ms when confirmed
system times are UTC ISO; available_at >= candle close; revision1 first_seen_at >= available_at; revision_recorded_at >= available_at

confirm block: grid/close/offset consistency; offset window A 0..1, B 1, C 1..10; first_confirmed_seen_at >= confirm close, >= first_seen_at, <= revision_recorded_at; legacy_confirm_time (A only) is discovery time >= confirm close; confirmed <=> confirm block; FIRST CONFIRMATION CAUSALITY (S1-R1-P2-03, validated together with earlier revisions): on the first revision carrying a confirm block revision_recorded_at == first_confirmed_seen_at and every source_versions.available_at (and event available_at) <= first_confirmed_seen_at; on any later revision first_confirmed_seen_at is preserved from the first confirmed revision (a legitimate source_revision may carry newer available_at / revision_recorded_at); revision>1 with a confirm block needs its earlier revisions to be validated
revision_id / prior_revision_id / revision_reason / revision_recorded_at linkage
evidence_hash recomputed from source_versions; available_at = max(source available_at); no source effective after the decision boundary
legacy_refs recomputed (A bind_identity / cycle-bound id; B stable_event_id == event_id)
event_kind belongs to strategy
session_id composition
tracking profile allowed per strategy (no weak profile); original_cycle_state in strategy enum; A reference kind none
C state mapping: invalidated -> ended/cycle_invalidated; expired -> C_expired_technical_observation + t0_low; confirmed -> C_confirmed_observation + cycle_low; waiting -> C_waiting_observation
ended <=> ended_at_bar_close_ms and end_reason; human_stop <=> human_stopped and ended
B session uses the original bev- event_id; B reference s0_risk_line or none
last_evaluated >= started; ended_at <= last_evaluated
transition_id composition
allowed transitions and reasons; nothing leaves 'ended'; paused -> ended only by human_stop/delisted_verified (never structure across a gap)
at_bar_close = at_bar_open + tf; recorded_at >= at_bar_close
revision>1 transitions need corrects_transition_id; revision 1 must not have it
